what: đèn sân vườn thấp: the low square lamp at the side of a path of the park of Bãi Trước (D-0026-08)
uses: Plan 0026, R9 and D-0026-08: the low lamps along the paths of the park (path_lamps of data/showcase/bai_truoc.json).

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: The park in the morning: a path of tiles with a granite curb, a low square white lamp at its side, two women on the path, a granite bench, clipped hedges along the paths, round clipped bushes, granite balls on the lawn, frangipani trees, a black post with white globes, raised lawns and coconut palms.

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: The park in the morning: a round flower bed with a ring of red leaves and low yellow green plants in it, a low square white lamp, clipped hedges and round clipped bushes, painted cat sculptures, frangipani trees, coconut palms, a black post with white globes, a blue lamp pole far away.

sources.author: Flickr user 10598985@N07
sources.shows: The park under frangipani trees: a dark grey post with five white globes, paths of red tiles, granite benches (a slab on two legs), low square white lamps, lawns, stone sculptures.

sources.author: Flickr user 146662501@N05
sources.shows: The walk of the sea of Bãi Trước to the south: four low square white lamps with dark bars along the hedge of the park, a light blue pole, the high plain wall to the sand.

height.source: Photo 0: the lamp is 58 px from its foot to the top of its cap, and the woman in green who walks by it is 131 px (1.58 m, a mean height of a woman); her feet and the foot of the lamp are at the same height in the photo, so they are at the same distance: 0.70 m.

cap_width.source: Photo 0: the cap is 13 to 14 px across at the scale of the woman beside it (131 px for 1.58 m, photo 0): 0.40 m.

body_width.source: Photo 0: the body is 28 px at the scale of the woman beside it (131 px for 1.58 m, photo 0): 0.34 m with its frame; 0.32 m.

body_height.source: Photo 0: 46 px of the 58 px of the lamp. 0.56 m, on a foot of 0.06 m.

panes.value: 2 columns on each side; a tall row between a band of 0.08 m at the top and one of 0.07 m at the bottom
panes.source: Photos 0 and 1, crops at full size: each side has a dark bar in its middle, a bar at each corner, and two dark rows across, near the top and near the bottom; the bands are about 1/7 and 1/8 of the body.

foot.source: estimate (no source): the hedge hides the foot in photo 0.

colors.source: Photo 0: frosted white panes; photo 2 (2018): the same white lamps. Photo 0: dark grey. The cap: photo 0, light grey.

cap.value: a slab of 0.40 m, 0.03 m thick, under a low hipped top of 0.05 m
cap.source: Photos 0 and 1, crops at full size: the cap is wider than the body and its top rises a little to the middle. The heights: estimate (no source), in the 0.08 m of the cap.

looks.note: Thin bars with a relief made spikes at the mid level (cells of 4 cm), and the colors did not show (the look tool and the game now show the colors at the points). The bars are now paint at the near level only.
Next to the crops of photos 0 and 1: four equal rows of panes and a flat cap are not as the photo. Now a tall row between two short bands, and a low hipped cap.

The near level next to the crops of photos 0 and 1: two tall panes on each side between the bands, a dark foot, a light grey hipped cap. The drawing is now the kind vuon_thap of the blueprint den_cong_vien, with the same edits.

looks.seen: The order of the kind vuon_thap of the blueprint den_cong_vien: the same shape as the drawing before.
As the near level of the drawing before (photos 0, 1 and 3).
The same edits of this kind. The blueprint den_cong_vien changed in the kind hai_tay only, so the order of this kind has a new hash.
